SOUTH SAN FRANCISCO, Calif., Sept. 02, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- ALX Oncology Holdings Inc. ("ALX Oncology"; Nasdaq: ALXO), a clinical-stage biotechnology company advancing a pipeline of novel therapies designed to treat cancer and extend patients’ lives, today announced that ALX Oncology leadership will participate in fireside chats at three upcoming investor conferences.


The details of the meetings are as follows:


**Wells Fargo 21** **st** **Annual Healthcare Conference**


Format: Fireside Chat and One-on-one Meetings
Date: Wednesday, September 9, 2026
Location: Boston, MA
Time of Fireside Chat Presentation: 3:45 PM ET
Webcast link: Available[here](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=0LzdvRMW0NQIa-zk69UbDSrpIAd_X7GnBL7Lh_G1LqNEcCp0tpQfRTY9y20ooBRDkySYhqMVWE_BhLCuvlsNRpFBoQ0M_L_lmMmVzsR4Hm5G8f0fYhm3anjYDSSaepSWvtphMo71HzEssxDD3ekUsQ==)


**Cantor Global Healthcare Conference**


Format: Fireside Chat and One-on-one Meetings
Date: Thursday, September 10, 2026
Location: New York, NY

Webcast link: Available[here](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=0LzdvRMW0NQIa-zk69UbDRm5NdbNvlRbSuqCVdtHtp4xPR_2FGnI3FyDnTPP6-pCshjL4DB89yB3SJOMN-YuXdAh_M7nUIcnMgXQOHxBJUiqj9ED-sApehOBJmWKjAy25SYJQwSOM6RQ02upUzULN9XmEqSeLIaOeqpbxrQLFiUc1iLjm7ljS81jnQtJHKKKmQQAp9BErJeuMn_EptElUFMixRFwmCwa7cU64tgH_9w=)

Webcast link: Available[here](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=0LzdvRMW0NQIa-zk69UbDXh7Z0-EKThZyZOA8DBK4da3yQXY4oeZYMDeHazaa8LtRcy0TeQmEPpUf0q5eeMpfwidZTUmdx4feSy0RV262QdHEQ2inZZFudKmnAXa77CJpDXsakX9cUWrWajCH73oYw==)

Replays of the webcasts will be archived for up to 90 days following the presentation dates.


**About ALX Oncology**
ALX Oncology (Nasdaq: ALXO) is a clinical-stage biotechnology company advancing a pipeline of novel therapies designed to treat cancer and extend patients’ lives. ALX Oncology’s lead therapeutic candidate, evorpacept, has demonstrated potential to serve as a cornerstone therapy upon which the future of immuno-oncology can be built. Evorpacept is currently being evaluated across multiple ongoing clinical trials in a wide range of cancer indications. ALX Oncology’s second pipeline candidate, ALX2004, is a novel EGFR-targeted antibody-drug conjugate with a differentiated mechanism of action. A Phase 1, dose-escalation trial of ALX2004 is ongoing in patients with EGFR-expressing solid tumors. More information is available at[www.alxoncology.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=589sYkXjQjytQTtJqP8bFftJrbHrpw-uzwHqX8z4y1OIU1LAV2ZsrX7fpsAGdXUblS1pKlf2oxgy6_u-0BxA6lKqJoPeDCdO2PEmR1WYv9c=) and on[LinkedIn](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=35Sjbu6yvderUJU438hSL0bKOkdbOisc3fNvtAHEJhmxYxwW76m0QyQ1cJ-ZS8IeKFE0Hkpw9bd-kTr5uzZSIARsdywo289qWdYF2-gLDeHxbY5MbPsWT_3ZLkPtqSsWZ26lS7euZjgE9QL7KbL8FA==) .
